$comment: The document is a post (contract/collections/posts.json) as the post view receives it: title, href, date (from publishedAt, in the site's time zone), readingMinutes, author resolved, and its layout split as section#sections-in-a-post draws it: body is the rich-text section that is prose alone, and sections[0] is the one section of the layout that draws as a band, with its field values as stored and its plan (track, index). One band per case, as the fixtures gate nests one section; post/band-* together use each section a post allows. The prose comes first in the layout.
summary: A post whose layout is prose with a stored h2 and h3, then a media-and-text section: the prose draws bare at base 1 (h2, h3), and the media and text draws as a band, its heading h2 under the post's h1. The featured image holds the priority image, so the band's image is lazy (section#sections-in-a-post).

document.title: Planting a lavender bed
document.body:
Lavender wants sun, poor soil and sharp drainage.

Preparing the ground

Dig in grit, not compost.

On clay

Raise the bed a hand high.

rows.heading: Planting that earns its place
rows.content: Every bed is chosen for the soil, the light and the season you want most.
